name: Octillery
normal: red body, yellow suckers and bumps, tan underside
shiny: red body turns mustard yellow (olive-gold), lower chroma; yellow bits shift slightly greener-yellow
note: Re-measured, confirmed. Red hue 20-40 (C0.22, 91% of the sprite) -> ~95 (C0.11, about x0.5), L about the same. Yellow bumps hue 80-100 -> ~108. Simulated mean error 0.017 vs 0.199 unrecolored.

name: Taillow

shiny: light green back, red-orange chest unchanged
note: Blue to green corroborated by several sources; draft 150 target kept but sources collapsed to one hue window.

name: Pelipper

shiny: white body, green feet/wings and body accents

name: Zangoose
normal: white fur, red markings, dark grey claws
shiny: red markings turn blue, claws turn orange-brown, white unchanged
desc: red markings turn blue, claws turn orange
note: Re-measured, confirmed. Red hue 0-20 (C0.18-0.2,L0.63) -> ~248 (C0.1,L0.70). Claws are dark near-grey (L~0.45,C~0.007) -> hue ~40, C~0.1, L up to ~0.6 (grey rule cannot raise L). White fur (L>0.85) unchanged. Simulated mean error 0.0135 vs 0.067 unrecolored.

name: Shroomish
normal: tan/cream cap and body, green spots and legs
shiny: green spots and legs become orange
note: Draft had normal and shiny colors reversed (red cap to green).

name: Seviper
normal: dark navy-teal body, yellow plates and face, red/pink tail blade and eye, lavender stripes
shiny: dark body turns lighter slate blue-grey, yellow plates turn green, red blade turns blue, lavender stripes turn pink
desc: body lightens to slate, yellow turns green, blade blue, stripes pink
note: Re-measured. Body hue 218-250 (C0.065,L0.34) -> ~250 (C0.036,L0.52, x1.55). Yellow plates hue 80-110 (C0.14-0.15) -> ~127-133 (C x0.72). Red blade/eye hue 350-30 is a clean single shift (not mixed) -> ~259 blue, C x0.52, L x1.06. Lavender stripes hue 270-295 (C0.08) -> ~357 pink (C x1.9, L x0.86). Simulated mean error 0.026 vs 0.169 unrecolored.

name: Torterra
normal: saturated green body and shell, brown trunk and rocks, pale blue-grey belly
shiny: green becomes olive green (duller, lighter), brown trunk turns yellow-green, pale belly nearly unchanged
desc: brown trunk turns yellow-green, green goes olive
note: Re-measured. Green hue 140-160 (C0.165,L0.60) -> ~135 (C x0.6, L x1.1). Brown trunk hue 60-70 (C0.09,L0.65) -> ~109 (C x1.44, L x1.16); window tightened from 78+-20 to 66+-14 to match. Pale belly C<0.03 barely moves, not encoded. Not teal. Simulated mean error 0.014 vs 0.095 unrecolored.

name: Leafeon
normal: green leaves/tail (H~155), tan-yellow body (H~90), brown ears/paws (H~65)
shiny: tan body slightly yellower/duller and a little darker; leaves slightly deeper, more saturated green; brown parts turn olive-tan
desc: subtle: body shifts yellower and duller, leaves slightly greener
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites; per-pixel aligned normal vs shiny, measured OKLCh hue shift/chroma/lightness
note: Pixel-aligned: tan H80-110 shifts -8..-15 deg, C x0.83, L x0.94; green H150-160 shifts -9, C x1.21, L x0.93; brown H63-70 (9%) shifts +26 to olive-tan, C x0.9; light yellow-green H119-123 (4%) +7, C x1.26. Overall subtle.

name: Manaphy
normal: blue body (H~205-230), light blue underside, small yellow/red parts
shiny: teal/cyan-green body (H~185-190), slightly lighter and less saturated
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites; per-pixel aligned normal vs shiny, measured OKLCh hue shift/chroma/lightness
note: Pixel-aligned: shift is not constant because shiny converges on H~187: H203-215 shifts -17..-25 (C x0.8, L x1.06), H219-231 (54%) shifts -33..-37 (C x0.7, L x1.04). Two rules approximate this. Yellow/red bits (5%) only lose a little chroma; not modeled.

name: Shaymin

shiny: teal/sea-green body (H~177), orange-pink flower (H~22), dark green leaves unchanged
desc: light green body turns teal, flower shifts toward orange-pink
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites; per-pixel aligned normal vs shiny, measured OKLCh hue shift/chroma/lightness
note: Land form, pixel-aligned: body H122-136 (42%) shifts +48, C x0.78, L x1.0; flower H0-10 (22%) shifts +17, C x0.89, L x0.92; dark green H146-152 (14%) shifts about -4 (unchanged). Body window is 7 wide because the 12 deg feather would otherwise pull in the dark green at H146+. Sky form not measured.

name: Bouffalant
normal: brown fur (H~62, C.10), cream horns/face (H~83), dark grey-brown fur
shiny: reddish-brown fur (H~32, C.083), peach-cream horns/face (H~43), darker overall
desc: brown fur turns reddish brown, cream turns peach
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites; per-pixel aligned normal vs shiny, measured OKLCh hue shift/chroma/lightness
note: Pixel-aligned: fur H59-68 (20%) shifts -31, C x0.81, L x0.89; cream H80-90 (13%) shifts about -40 (bin H80 mixed, -17), chroma unchanged (x0.98), L x1.03. The dark grey fur (55% of pixels, L .54 to .43) cannot be darkened by the grammar (grey rules only tint), so it is not covered; medium confidence.

name: Inkay
normal: blue body (H~230, C.084), pale near-white head with faint pink tint (H~346, C.015)
shiny: gold body (H~90, C.10), light violet head (H~310, C.06)
desc: blue body turns gold, pale head turns light violet
source: pokemondb.net HOME sprites; per-pixel aligned normal vs shiny, measured OKLCh hue shift/chroma/lightness
note: Pixel-aligned: body H220-240 (29%) shifts -145 to H~90, C x1.2, L x1.0. Head (normal L .85-.92, C .014-.02) becomes violet H~310 C~.06; true white parts (L>.95, C~0) stay white, so the grey tint is limited to L .86-.92 to avoid tinting them. Other pale areas share that lightness band, so confidence medium.
